question.summary: General random channels violate multiplicativity, but no verified new counterexample has been found inside the intended cyclic sub-unitary family.
question.importance: The problem tests whether the rigid cyclic Kraus structure can support the multiplicativity violations known for less structured random channels.
question.unresolved: Construct a multiplicativity counterexample in the corrected random sub-unitary class, or prove a positive theorem excluding one in a stated p-range.
